prompt:
Create EXACTLY EIGHT separate full-body poses of the SAME detailed semi-realistic Dwarf Lord Blacksmith, in a four-column two-row sprite sheet with generous transparent gutters. FIRST image is the physical walking pose guide: reproduce its eight anatomical leg/arm phases, body location, same scale and rear-right viewing angle. BLUE in the guide is anatomical LEFT, GOLD is anatomical RIGHT; those colors are guides ONLY, final clothes stay as SECOND image. SECOND image supplies identity/clothes/perspective ONLY, not its repeated leg pose. Bald massive stocky older dwarf with very muscular forearms, heavy charcoal-black beard visible at right cheek, worn cream linen rolled sleeves, dark brown weathered leather smith apron, X-crossed leather back straps with brass ring, dark brown trousers, two full sturdy strapped brown boots, brass buckles. Keep the exact same fixed elevated three-quarter BACK-RIGHT camera: viewer sees mostly his back and near LEFT side; head/body always face upper RIGHT. Same X straps, proportions, identity, cloth, apron and boots all eight. Do NOT rotate toward side/front, do NOT repeat the same leading leg in both halves, do not mirror.

Pose order LEFT to RIGHT on top (0-3), then LEFT to RIGHT below (4-7). FOLLOW GUIDE LEG OCCLUSION AND JOINT CHAINS. 0: far RIGHT heel strikes ahead toward upper-right, near LEFT toe trails lower-left; LEFT arm forward and RIGHT arm back. 1: RIGHT planted flat moves modestly back relative to pelvis, LEFT trailing heel recovers. 2: RIGHT firmly supports under pelvis; near LEFT knee comes forward, LEFT boot raised and moving past support, separate connected thighs. 3: RIGHT supporting toe pushes off behind, LEFT boot reaches ahead upper-right airborne, LEFT arm now back and RIGHT arm forward. 4: near LEFT heel now lands clearly ahead upper-right while RIGHT toe trails behind lower-left; LEFT arm back, RIGHT arm forward. 5: near LEFT planted flat supports, far RIGHT trailing heel rises. 6: near LEFT supports under pelvis while far RIGHT knee/boot recover airborne forward past LEFT, anatomically separate and partly occluded naturally. 7: LEFT toe pushes off behind, RIGHT boot reaches forward upper-right for next0, LEFT arm forward/RIGHT arm back. Every boot attaches through correct shin/knee/thigh to same anatomical hip, no changing limb ownership. Real heels/toes, modest dwarf step spacing, no giant split. Arms small counter-swing opposite ipsilateral leg, no duplicated hands. Standing root height/hip/head width common for all poses. Smooth distinct successive poses, no extra objects/tools, no labels/numbering/colored guides, no floor/cast shadow, no red/green outline. Genuine transparent RGBA. No clipped heads, hands, apron or toes. Exactly4x2 layout, whole sprites centered in equal cells.
